northStar: risk-adjusted cleared contribution profit / founder minute

scoring.purpose: Evidence-weighted decision index, not demand, probability, valuation, or revenue.

economicGenes.description: A dated duty or entitlement creates urgency without manufacturing demand.
Payment, credit, acceptance, remediation, or release depends on reconstructable proof.
One intermediary controls trusted access to many downstream accounts and has room for resale margin.
Normal flow is automated while exceptions are detected, evidenced, prioritized, and routed.
Buyer-owned acceptance criteria turn delivery quality into a deterministic approve, reject, or inconclusive receipt.
A bounded evidence sprint becomes a repeatable monitor, then a partner control plane or embedded API only after repeated accepted use.

bestOriginalInvention.name: Partner Evidence Rail
bestOriginalInvention.mechanism: An authorized intermediary resells client-branded exception, reconciliation, and acceptance evidence across its portfolio; repeated delivery can mature from sprint to monitor to embedded rail.
bestOriginalInvention.firstUnit: White-label Lead-Path Revenue Leak Evidence Sprint
promotionGates: At least two downstream paid accounts activated by one partner within 60 days.
After the third accepted account, fulfilment consumes under two founder hours per account.
Partner margin hypothesis of at least 30 percent survives actual pricing and support evidence.
No production or customer-system access occurs without explicit consent and scoped authority.

tournament.why: The offer, evidence pack, bounded price hypothesis, partner channel, acceptance packet, and zero-effect canary already exist; it has the shortest reversible path to payment evidence.
killConditions: No qualified partner accepts the bounded evidence-only scope.
Delivery cannot be standardized within the founder-minute ceiling.
A partner will not preserve permission, evidence, and truthful attribution boundaries.

tournament.why: Official UAE and Saudi rollout dates create mandatory exception workflows and accredited-provider channels, but no buyer commitment proves UberBond adds value beyond existing validators.
tournament.promotionGate: A qualified provider supplies a safe sample and a stronger payment commitment than the current canary.
killConditions: The pack adds no material evidence beyond provider validators.
The buyer requires tax advice, filing authority, or compliance liability.
No paid pilot follows five qualified provider conversations.

tournament.why: Official procurement and risk guidance supports buyer-owned holdout evaluation, reproducibility, thresholds, monitoring, and rollback. It is strategically aligned but has a slower first-sale path than the prepared canary.
killConditions: Agencies will not pay separately or bundle the evidence into a paid engagement.
Generic observability vendors satisfy buyer acceptance without independent evidence.

tournament.why: Official SLA claim windows create a find-money mechanism, but recovered value is usually a future service credit and access to provider logs and billing data raises friction.
killConditions: Credits are too small or too infrequent to support partner economics.
Provider-native claim tooling removes the evidence gap.
The offer requires broad cloud-admin credentials.

tournament.why: The labor and overturned-denial evidence is strong, but HIPAA, BAAs, clinical risk, integration, and liability make it an inferior first-customer path.
killConditions: Clinical or legal judgment cannot be separated from evidence preparation.
Integration and compliance costs dominate the initial contract.

killedTheses.reason: Crowded, hard to differentiate, and weakly tied to acceptance or payment. Revisit only with buyer-owned acceptance evidence and a channel.
Native payment and commerce platforms own distribution and automate much of the workflow. Revisit only as an exception atom inside a broader evidence rail.
Founder-dependent distribution and commodity fulfilment fail the founder-minute objective.

beliefUpdates.beliefBefore: The GCC advantage might support a broad Arabic AI-operations offer.
beliefUpdates.newEvidence: Official UAE and Saudi e-invoicing rollout rules create dated exception and correction workflows routed through accredited or qualifying providers.
beliefUpdates.beliefAfter: The defensible GCC wedge is a bilingual exception-evidence layer behind providers, not a broad Arabic AI claim.

beliefUpdates.beliefBefore: A partner directory or reseller badge could provide distribution.
beliefUpdates.newEvidence: Strong channel systems combine portfolio control, multi-client workflow, visible customer proof, and explicit recurring partner margin.
beliefUpdates.beliefAfter: A partner becomes distribution only when the offer creates downstream profit and is operationally repeatable across the portfolio.

highestValueExperiment.offer: $450 white-label Lead-Path Revenue Leak Evidence Sprint
highestValueExperiment.successEvidence: Cleared payment, accepted evidence delivery, actual founder minutes, partner margin, and a second downstream account.
highestValueExperiment.killRule: Do not continue after the bounded canary if payment, accepted delivery, or repeatable partner economics fail.

claudeHandoff.problem: AI vendors lack independent buyer-owned proof that a specific system version meets contractual acceptance and remains acceptable after model, provider, tool, or prompt changes.
claudeHandoff.economicValue: A compact evidence-pack compiler can help implementation partners close and defend paid AI work, create a recurring regression route, and supply the strategic acceptance atom of the Partner Evidence Rail.
claudeHandoff.requiredCapability: Compose existing task-intent acceptance criteria, capability benchmark execution, consequence receipts, and payment-acceptance truth into a deterministic acceptance evidence-pack compiler; do not build a parallel evaluator platform.
claudeHandoff.successCriterion: With synthetic fixtures and two candidate systems, reproducibly emit APPROVE, REJECT, or INCONCLUSIVE; detect one seeded regression and one unauthorized side effect; pin hashes, model, provider, tools, permissions, cost, and evidence; emit machine-readable and client-readable reports.
boundaries: No fund custody or payment initiation.
claudeHandoff.whyThisDominatesOtherEngineeringWork: It is the smallest missing reusable primitive that links existing evidence, safety, acceptance, and reconciliation systems to a partner-sellable recurring outcome. It remains behind the commercial canary until buyer evidence justifies implementation.

remainingUnknowns: Will an intermediary pay separately for independent evidence and activate at least two downstream accounts, or expect the work bundled for free?
Can the first three accepted deliveries stay below the founder-minute ceiling while preserving evidence quality?
Does the GCC exception pack add enough value beyond provider validators to justify a paid wholesale relationship?
